      "unit": "F038",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary"],
        "statement": "Effective July 1, 1974, all functions of the Secretary of Labor under section 3 of the Act entitled 'An Act to provide for the establishment of a national employment system and for cooperation with the States in the promotion of such system, and for other purposes', approved June 6, 1933 (29 U.S.C. 49–49k), with respect to the maintenance of a public employment service for the District of Columbia, are transferred to the Commissioner of the District of Columbia.",

      "unit_attributes": {

        "statement": "After the effective date of the transfer of functions (July 1, 1974), the Secretary must maintain with the District of Columbia the same relationship with respect to a public employment service in the District, including the financing of such service, as he has with the States (with respect to a public employment service in the States) generally.",

    {
      "unit": "F093",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary", "term.state"],
        "statement": "The Secretary must assist in coordinating the State public employment service offices throughout the country and in increasing their usefulness by developing and prescribing minimum standards of efficiency, assisting them in meeting problems peculiar to their localities, promoting uniformity in their administrative and statistical procedure, furnishing and publishing information as to opportunities for employment and other information of value in the operation of the system, and maintaining a system for clearing labor between the States.",

        "actor_quote": "The Secretary shall assist",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,

        "modality_quote": "shall assist",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,

    {
      "unit": "F096",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary", "term.state", "term.state_agency"],
        "statement": "The Secretary must assure that unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State, as appropriate, upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 601 et seq.], of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act [42 U.S.C. 651 et seq.], or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.), shall furnish to such requesting agency, from any data contained in the files of any such office, information with respect to any individual specified in the request as to: (1) whether such individual is receiving, has received, or has made application for, unemployment compensation, and the amount of any such compensation being received by such individual; (2) the current (or most recent) home address of such individual; and (3) whether such individual has refused an offer of employment and, if so, a description of the employment so offered and the terms, conditions, and rate of pay therefor.",
        "actor": "the Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "duty of the Secretary to assure",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be the duty of the Secretary to assure",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "part A of title IV of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 601 et seq.]",
          "part D of title IV of such Act [42 U.S.C. 651 et seq.]",
          "Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F096",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.state", "term.state_agency"],
        "statement": "Notwithstanding any other provision of law, unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State, as appropriate, are authorized, upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 601 et seq.], of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act [42 U.S.C. 651 et seq.], or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.), to furnish to such requesting agency, from any data contained in the files of any such office, information with respect to any individual specified in the request as to: (1) whether such individual is receiving, has received, or has made application for, unemployment compensation, and the amount of any such compensation being received by such individual; (2) the current (or most recent) home address of such individual; and (3) whether such individual has refused an offer of employment and, if so, a description of the employment so offered and the terms, conditions, and rate of pay therefor.",
        "actor": "unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State",

        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F099",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary", "term.state"],
        "statement": "The Secretary must assist in the coordination and development of a nationwide system of public labor exchange services, provided as part of the one-stop customer service systems of the States.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary shall—",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,

        "modality_quote": "shall",

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F100",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary"],
        "statement": "The Secretary must assist in the development of continuous improvement models for the nationwide system of public labor exchange services that ensure private sector satisfaction with the system and meet the demands of jobseekers relating to the system, and must identify and disseminate information on best practices for such system.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary shall—",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,

        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F102",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary"],
        "statement": "The Secretary must ensure, for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation, the provision of reemployment services and other activities in which the individuals are required to participate to receive the compensation.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary shall—",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation",
        "scope_quotes": ["F102"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F104",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.secretary", "term.state_agency", "term.workforce_development_activity", "term.workplace_learning_advisor"],
        "statement": "The Secretary must, in coordination with the State agencies and the staff of such agencies, assist in the planning and implementation of activities to enhance the professional development and career advancement opportunities of such staff, in order to strengthen the provision of a broad range of career guidance services, the identification of job openings (including providing intensive outreach to small and medium-sized employers and enhanced employer services), the provision of technical assistance and training to other providers of workforce development activities (including workplace learning advisors) relating to counseling and employment-related services, and the development of new strategies for coordinating counseling and technology.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary shall—",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F107",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["term.employment_service_office", "term.one_stop_center", "term.state"],
        "statement": "In order to improve service delivery, avoid duplication of services, and enhance coordination of services, including location of staff to ensure access to services under section 49f(a) of this title statewide in underserved areas, employment service offices in each State must be colocated with one-stop centers.",
        "actor": null,

unit_attributes.statement: In order to promote the establishment and maintenance of a national system of public employment service offices, the United States Employment Service must be established and maintained within the Department of Labor.
The Act of June 6, 1933, ch. 49 (enacting this chapter) may be cited as the 'Wagner-Peyser Act'.

Effective July 1, 1974, all functions of the Secretary of Labor under section 3 of the Act entitled 'An Act to provide for the establishment of a national employment system and for cooperation with the States in the promotion of such system, and for other purposes', approved June 6, 1933 (29 U.S.C. 49–49k), with respect to the maintenance of a public employment service for the District of Columbia, are transferred to the Commissioner of the District of Columbia.

After the effective date of the transfer of functions (July 1, 1974), the Secretary must maintain with the District of Columbia the same relationship with respect to a public employment service in the District, including the financing of such service, as he has with the States (with respect to a public employment service in the States) generally.
unit_attributes.actor_quote: the Secretary shall maintain with the District
unit_attributes.scope_text: After the effective date of this transfer [July 1, 1974]

unit_attributes.statement: Except as otherwise provided, definitions in section 3 of Pub. L. 113–128 (classified to section 3102 of this title) apply to section 49a.

The Secretary must assist in coordinating the State public employment service offices throughout the country and in increasing their usefulness by developing and prescribing minimum standards of efficiency, assisting them in meeting problems peculiar to their localities, promoting uniformity in their administrative and statistical procedure, furnishing and publishing information as to opportunities for employment and other information of value in the operation of the system, and maintaining a system for clearing labor between the States.

The Secretary must assure that unemployment insurance and employment service offices in each State, as appropriate, upon request of a public agency administering or supervising the administration of a State program funded under part A of title IV of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 601 et seq.], of a public agency charged with any duty or responsibility under any program or activity authorized or required under part D of title IV of such Act [42 U.S.C. 651 et seq.], or of a State agency charged with the administration of the supplemental nutrition assistance program in a State under the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 (7 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.), shall furnish to such requesting agency, from any data contained in the files of any such office, information with respect to any individual specified in the request as to: (1) whether such individual is receiving, has received, or has made application for, unemployment compensation, and the amount of any such compensation being received by such individual; (2) the current (or most recent) home address of such individual; and (3) whether such individual has refused an offer of employment and, if so, a description of the employment so offered and the terms, conditions, and rate of pay therefor.

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary must assist in the coordination and development of a nationwide system of public labor exchange services, provided as part of the one-stop customer service systems of the States.

The Secretary must assist in the development of continuous improvement models for the nationwide system of public labor exchange services that ensure private sector satisfaction with the system and meet the demands of jobseekers relating to the system, and must identify and disseminate information on best practices for such system.

The Secretary must ensure, for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation, the provision of reemployment services and other activities in which the individuals are required to participate to receive the compensation.
unit_attributes.scope_text: for individuals otherwise eligible to receive unemployment compensation

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary must, in coordination with the State agencies and the staff of such agencies, assist in the planning and implementation of activities to enhance the professional development and career advancement opportunities of such staff, in order to strengthen the provision of a broad range of career guidance services, the identification of job openings (including providing intensive outreach to small and medium-sized employers and enhanced employer services), the provision of technical assistance and training to other providers of workforce development activities (including workplace learning advisors) relating to counseling and employment-related services, and the development of new strategies for coordinating counseling and technology.

In order to improve service delivery, avoid duplication of services, and enhance coordination of services, including location of staff to ensure access to services under section 49f(a) of this title statewide in underserved areas, employment service offices in each State must be colocated with one-stop centers.

The Secretary, in consultation with States, is authorized to assist the States in the development of national electronic tools that may be used to improve access to workforce information for individuals through: (1) the one-stop delivery systems established as described in section 3151(e) of this title; and (2) such other delivery systems as the Secretary determines to be appropriate.
unit_attributes.actor_quote: The Secretary, in consultation with States, is authorized
